app_identity.name: Uniyra AI Lab
app_identity.tagline: The High-Precision AI Research & Model Evaluation Operating System
app_identity.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast Precision) + Tactical Developer Tool Workstation
app_identity.theme_mode: Light mode default with seamless Dark mode toggle
app_identity.viewport: Desktop-first optimized for 1440p and multi-monitor research setups

design_principles: Precision over Ornamentation: Zero decorative slop. Hairline 1px borders, high-density telemetry, sharp visual hierarchy.
Single-Pane Ergonomics: Inspired by VS Code, Linear, and Raycast — resizable split panes, command palette (Cmd+K), persistent top telemetry rail.
Deterministic Telemetry: Real-time tracking of latency (ms), Time-to-First-Token (TTFT), throughput (tok/s), cost ($/1k tokens), and memory footprint across every run.
Full Research Lineage: Project -> Research Session -> Experiment -> Run -> Response -> AI Evaluation -> Finding -> Artifact.
Tactical Accessibility: Universal data-testid attributes on every button, input, tab, card, panel, and model selector.

typography.font_feature_settings: ss01, ss03, cv02, cv11 (tabular numerals enabled for latency/costs)

shell_structure.left_sidebar: Collapsible 64px (collapsed) / 240px (expanded) navigation rail with workspace switcher, core app links, registry, settings, and profile controls.
shell_structure.top_telemetry_bar: Persistent 44px instrument rail displaying active project badge, global latency ping, current token budget usage, API health indicators, global search trigger, and theme toggle.
shell_structure.main_view_container: Flex-1 overflow-y-auto background-canvas with support for resizable multi-column split panes via react-resizable-panels.

home_overview.purpose: Command center displaying high-level AI R&D health, active research sessions, experiment runs summary, and provider latency status.
widgets: Live System Telemetry Bar (Active Models, Total Runs, Avg Latency, Cost budget)
Active Research Sessions & Quick Workspace Launcher
Model Provider Connection Status Grid (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Local Ollama)

workspace_playground.purpose: Interactive prompt engineering sandbox with single & multi-model comparison, system prompt controls, hyperparameter tuning (temperature, top_p, max_tokens), markdown rendering, code block runner, and live token usage breakdown.
features: Parameter Sliders (Temperature, Top_P, Max Tokens, Presence Penalty)
Live Telemetry Footer (Latency ms, TTFT, Tokens/sec, Cost $)
Formatted Output Cards with Raw JSON & Markdown toggles

model_arena.purpose: Side-by-side prompt testing across 2 to 4 AI models simultaneously with synchronized input, live streaming response feeds, and per-panel metrics.
modes: Standard Arena: Clear model branding and side-by-side performance breakdown.
Blind Arena: Models anonymized as Model A, Model B, Model C, Model D. Researcher votes on best response before clicking 'Reveal Models'.

ai_judge.purpose: Automated evaluation engine that uses a judge LLM (e.g. Claude 3.5 Sonnet / GPT-4o) to evaluate and rank model outputs against multi-dimensional rubrics.
ai_judge.outputs: Structured Scorecards, Radar Chart visualization, Leaderboard ranking, and Critique Log.

ai_council.purpose: Multi-agent deliberative panel where specialized AI personas (e.g. Chief Architect, Security Auditor, Domain Researcher, Skeptic) execute multi-round discussion.

research_sessions.purpose: Notebook-style organized research logs linking hypotheses, prompt variations, telemetry findings, and notes.

experiments_and_runs.purpose: Version-controlled experiment tracker showing structured runs matrix, parameter diffs, and benchmark scores.

artifacts_and_findings.purpose: Knowledge base capturing validated prompts, golden test sets, system schemas, and verified empirical findings.
features: Findings with direct evidence links to specific Run IDs

provider_and_model_registry.purpose: Infrastructure manager to configure API keys, test endpoint connections, set rate limits, toggle active models, and benchmark provider ping latency.

settings_and_auth.purpose: User management, workspace preferences, API key encryption vault, telemetry storage limits, and export tools.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete desktop workstation web app in React with clean, modular components inside `/app/frontend/src/`.
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid='navigation-sidebar', data-testid='model-selector-dropdown', data-testid='run-experiment-button').
Implement light mode default with a dark mode toggle in the top telemetry rail.
Provide rich mock data and real state management so researchers can run Arena comparisons, trigger AI Judge evaluations, run Council discussions, create Findings, and test Provider API health pings.
Ensure responsiveness and split pane layout functionality for 1440p desktop screens.
Do NOT use heavy solid gradients or decorative AI cliparts. Maintain the crisp, high-density aesthetics of Linear and Raycast.
